run_make_submission_file: run the CLI script to create an evalAI submission file from OC20 or OC22 split results
run_write_predictions: run write_predictions to merge split result files into a single compressed NPZ submission file
run_write_is2re_relaxations: run write_is2re_relaxations to extract energies from ASE trajectory files for IS2RE submissions
run_main: run main to validate split arguments and orchestrate prediction file creation for a chosen dataset
run_hybrid_is2re: run the script with --hybrid to write IS2RE results from S2EF prediction NPZ files
